snippet.title: Disney Star Darlings App!
snippet.description:
Make your way through a day in the life of a Star Darling! Get to know statistic secrets about the Star Darlings through StarZap profiles, practice granting wishes to become the best wish-granter, and sing along with the hit music video "Wish Now!"
